approach: All six Option A resulting-polarity cast base events plus separately tagged moving-line events enter ordinary PFM before development. C carries PFM across 88 workings. Reader gets no target or plant labels.

reference.startState: fresh canonical separately for each reference cast
reference.standardDeviation: population sqrt(mean squared deviation), measured separately for every zone and readout
reference.zeroSigma: STOP for that candidate/readout/window; no floor or post-hoc replacement

margin.record: min changed-zone standardized feature difference; min within-output Hamming-1 score difference; number of tied score vectors; strain saturation; zero effects
margin.retiredTwoSigma: Retired as D1 eligibility, NOT erased from D0 evidence

plantedSignal.syntheticCast: fair three-coin 6/7/8/9, one of six lines chosen uniformly then forced to uniform synthetic target resulting bit and made young (7 or 8)
plantedSignal.target: uniform synthetic hexagram 0-63, never passed to reader
plantedSignal.paired: Identical casts, target, planted-line choice across all candidate/window/readout comparisons
plantedSignal.P1: exact BigInt integer-frequency convolution of conditional 64-way doubled midrank histograms, one-sided rank-sum lower tail, p <= 1/20
plantedSignal.raw: same resulting-hexagram agreement readout for every condition
selectionRule: highest number of design selection series rejecting P1 exact at alpha 0.05 (C)
smallest mean planted-target ordinary midrank across design selection series
largest DESCRIPTIVE minimum changed-zone standardized margin at FRESH/W88
plantedSignal.holdoutPolicy: Evaluate separate 12 disjoint held-out design series AFTER selection, report without revising selected design option or constants
plantedSignal.noRejectionRequirement: No D1 sensitivity cutoff and no margin gate; if all candidates at/below raw null baseline or low detection, report selection candidate as exploratory with NO-GO for freezing

fixedK3Calibration.warning: These later calibration gates are never applied to D1 design data and cannot be modified

sourceFreeze: D1 analysis code and all constants committed before GitHub D1 execution. Changes after outputs require documented incident and fresh design-series identifier; no silent threshold repair.
forbidden: promotion of tested constants as frozen production parameters
